You will develop product vision, design and manage product roadmaps based on the strategic goals of the agency you are serving. Working closely with colleagues specialising in user experience and engineering teams, you will conduct research, conceptualise features and ensure that they are rolled out successfully and on time. You will also define appropriate metrics, supervise consumer behaviour and perform data analysis to provide updates on feature performance. Own the product lifecycle end-to-end (discovery → build → launch → iteration), ensuring outcomes are realised post-launch. Comfort working with governance constraints (auditability, security, privacy) and designing practical solutions within them.
